post.description:
In which US state was BASKETBALL invented? Guess first — then watch the state outline draw itself and zoom to the gym where James Naismith hung two peach baskets in December 1891.

What was your first guess? Do share in the comments below.

Sources: Springfield College (Birthplace of Basketball), Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame, Wikipedia (History of basketball, Basketball court), Britannica.
